description: The line plot compares the BLEU scores of two different approaches to machine translation under the prefix-constrained decoding setting, with the x-axis representing the length of the gold prefix in tokens. The x-axis ranges from 0 to 20 tokens, with tick labels at intervals of 5 tokens. The y-axis represents the BLEU score, ranging from 23 to 29, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The blue line, representing the "Consistency: wait-1" approach, shows a generally increasing trend in BLEU score as the length of the gold prefix increases, starting at a score of approximately 24 and ending at a score of approximately 28. The red line, representing the "Inconsistency: wait-9" approach, shows more fluctuation in BLEU score, with values ranging from approximately 23 to 26, and ending at a score of approximately 26. The plot illustrates the performance of each approach as the length of the gold prefix changes, with the "Consistency: wait-1" approach generally outperforming the "Inconsistency: wait-9" approach.
